definitions.explanation: Indicates that a reservation or booking has been completed.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予約済|よやくず}みです。
⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{予約済|よやくず}みな⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{安心|あんしん}して→安心する：06067_anshinsuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: The hotel is already booked, so don't worry.

examples.japanese: {予約済|よやくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦メール→メール：04435_meeru⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{届|とど}いたら→届く：00899_todoku⟧、⟦{当日|とうじつ}→当日：04558_toujitsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{受付|うけつけ}→受付：01325_uketsuke⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{伝|つた}える→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: Once you receive the reservation confirmation email, on the day itself you just need to give your name at reception.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧ (reservation) and {済|す}み (completed, done — the noun form of ⟦{済|す}む→済む：01950_sumu⟧). The ～{済|す}み suffix is a productive pattern meaning "already done" or "completed," and attaches to many nouns and verb stems.

USAGE:
- Can function as a noun or a no-adjective: {予約済|よやくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧ (a reserved seat)
- Often seen on signs, labels, and in written notifications
- The ～{済|す}み pattern is very productive: {支払|しはら}い{済|す}み (paid), ⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧{済|す}み (confirmed), ⟦{登録|とうろく}→登録：05703_touroku⟧{済|す}み (registered)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {予約済|よやくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{席|せき}→席：02215_seki⟧: a reserved seat
- {予約済|よやくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧: a booked room
- {予約済|よやくず}み⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: reservation confirmation

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦{完了|かんりょう}→完了：02560_kanryou⟧: reservation completed — more formal; used in system messages
- ⟦{確保|かくほ}→確保：13681_kakuho⟧{済|す}み: secured — broader; used for resources, seats, or items that have been secured
- ⟦{手配|てはい}→手配：07604_tehai⟧{済|す}み: arranged — implies the arrangement or procurement has been completed
